claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2025, Upstart had more than 100 lending partners (banks and credit unions) on its AI lending marketplace.
claims.rationale: Quantified partner-count claim; bank-partner relationships are material to UPST's business model. Counterparty-disclosure threshold (Heuristic 7) — material UPST bank-partner relationships should appear in the bank's regulatory filings.

queries.purpose: Count external SEC filings (any cik) mentioning Upstart — proxy for partner-corroboration breadth.
Capital One (a representative large bank partner candidate) — does the bank acknowledge Upstart in its filings?

claims.claim_text: In the year ended December 31, 2025, Upstart's top three lending partners collectively originated 83% of loans facilitated through the marketplace and revenue from these lending partners accounted for 61% of total revenue.
claims.rationale: Quantified customer-concentration claim disclosed in 10-K. Disclosure-quality test: even if specific names are omitted, the magnitude is internally consistent; an M-side check is essentially N/A (these are private commercial arrangements). Expect UNVERIFIABLE per cohort calibration.

queries.purpose: Cross River Bank is historically UPST's largest single bank partner. Any SEC mentions of Cross River Bank (a privately-held NJ bank) corroborate UPST's bank-partner ecosystem.

claims.claim_text: In 2025, 91% of loans on Upstart's platform were fully automated, with no human intervention by Upstart.
claims.rationale: Quantified automation-rate claim. Operational metric, no clean M-registry analog (consumer-credit automation rates not in any registry). Per cohort calibration this will likely be UNVERIFIABLE.

queries.purpose: Count of unrelated-filer corroboration of the Upstart automation/AI claims (asymmetric mention test).

claims.claim_text: Upstart's personal loan underwriting model uses over 2,500 variables and is trained on nearly 104 million repayment events as of December 31, 2025.
claims.rationale: Quantified AI-model-scale claim. Patents are the only weak M-side anchor — proprietary models. Fintech patent counts typically low (Heuristic 8).

queries.purpose: Granted patent count for Upstart Network (operating subsidiary); fintech patent-light expectation.
Broader short-name fallback for patent applications/grants.

claims.claim_text: During the year ended December 31, 2025, of the total principal of loan originations facilitated on Upstart's marketplace, 64% were purchased by institutional investors, 26% retained or purchased by lending partners, and 10% held on Upstart's balance sheet.
claims.rationale: Quantified breakdown of origination disposition. Crucially separates platform (origination) volume from balance-sheet (credit) risk — this is the Heuristic-3 STAGE-LADDER disclosure quality discriminator for UPST.

queries.purpose: Distinctive product-name phrase used by Upstart for loans sold to ABS investors. External use signals corroboration by securitization investors / trustees.

claims.claim_text: Upstart's Auto Finance software is deployed at auto dealerships and powers loans for the auto-retail business (Upstart Auto Retail).
claims.rationale: Named product-line claim. No registry analog for dealership-software deployments; auto OEMs/dealerships are generally not SEC filers individually. Expect UNVERIFIABLE.

queries.purpose: Direct external mentions of the Upstart Auto Retail product across all SEC filers.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2025, Upstart's convertible senior notes had an aggregate principal balance of $1,687.8 million (across 2026, 2029, 2030, and 2032 Notes).
claims.rationale: Quantified balance-sheet liability disclosure. The 2026 Notes mature within ~12 months of cutoff — refinancing/maturity wall is a distress marker (Heuristic 10). Filings themselves are the registry — this is a self-consistent financial-statement claim.

queries.purpose: Confirm own-filer disclosure consistency for the convert structure (high prior likelihood of corroboration; UNVERIFIABLE-equivalent if no independent registry).

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2025, Upstart held $984.6 million of loans on its consolidated balance sheet, of which $647.2 million were originated for research-and-development purposes (auto, HELOC, expansion products) and $283.6 million were core personal loans.
claims.rationale: Balance-sheet loan exposure quantified — directly tests Heuristic 9 (origination volume vs balance-sheet volume). Internal financial-statement claim; no external registry analog.

queries.purpose: Confirm own-filer fact (sanity check — should return >=1).
